method: triangulate each matched point independently in its calibrated rig frame, aggregate shared 3D-to-3D tracks by bounded frame gap, estimate relative SE(3) with deterministic Kabsch RANSAC, and compare metric translation with the reconstructed rig motion
complexity: bounded by stereo track observations times configured frame gap plus per-supported-frame-pair RANSAC; no image-pair Cartesian product

implementation.synthetic_contract: recovers a known 1 m metric translation at ratio 1.0 without trajectory ground truth

one_k_short_gap_1_to_2.verdict: unobservable because real inter-frame motion is far below stereo depth noise

one_k_exact_gap_128.verdict: observable but only the first 500-frame region has enough exact-gap support at 10k

post_mapping_gt_cross_check.verdict: the stereo-track estimate points in the wrong correction direction in the known drift region

decision: do not add these sparse relative translations as mapper constraints: support nearly disappears across frames 2000-3999 and the surviving frame-3000 signal would enlarge rather than correct the independently measured scale drift
